title: Images of open subsets under a proper injective chart are relatively open
statement: Let P, d ∈ ℕ, M, W ⊆ ℝ^P, V, V₁ ⊆ ℝ^d and ψ : ℝ^d → ℝ^P. Assume W is open, ψ is continuous on V and injective on V, ψ(V) = W ∩ M, V ∩ ψ⁻¹(K) is compact for every compact K ⊆ W, V₁ is open and V₁ ⊆ V. Then there is an open set N₀ ⊆ ℝ^P with M ∩ N₀ = ψ(V₁).
lean_statement: ∀ (P d : ℕ) (M W : Set (Euclid P)) (V V₁ : Set (Euclid d)) (ψ : Euclid d → Euclid P), IsOpen W → ContinuousOn ψ V → InjOn ψ V → ψ '' V = W ∩ M → (∀ K ⊆ W, IsCompact K → IsCompact (V ∩ ψ ⁻¹' K)) → IsOpen V₁ → V₁ ⊆ V → ∃ N₀ : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen N₀ ∧ M ∩ N₀ = ψ '' V₁
